name: webauthn-service
description: Sidecar service handling WebAuthn/passkey registration and login ceremonies for CLUSTR. Neither PocketBase nor self-hosted Supabase has native WebAuthn support, so the actual attestation/assertion cryptography lives here (via @simplewebauthn/server), talking to GoTrue/PostgREST over plain fetch — no Supabase client SDK needed for a service-role-only backend caller.
